title: TickerBox snapshot
description: internal/section.Snapshot, as written by `tickerbox config export` and read back by `tickerbox config import`/`config diff`. A profile file written by `tickerbox profile save` and read back by `profile apply`/`profile diff` is the wider `$defs/profileRecord` shape below, not this bare object.

profileRecord.description: internal/profile.record: the file `profile save` writes and `profile apply`/`profile diff` read, a superset of the bare snapshot above.

description.description: Set by `profile save --description`; omitted when empty.

source_device.description: The device name a profile was saved from; omitted when empty.

deviceSection.description: Passed through from the device's REST response as-is; the CLI does not constrain its fields beyond stripping secrets. Present only when the snapshot includes this section.

ticker.description: Device-recognized symbol, e.g. BTC or AAPL. Not validated by the CLI.
